### Meaning
| infl.      | class      | meaning                                                             |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~          | *n.*       | bounce, jump, leap, hop, rebound, ricochet reflection, deflection   |
| ~en        | *v.*       | to bounce, jump, leap, hop / be reflected, be deflected, bounce off |
| ...thu ~en | *caus. v.* | to deflect                                                          |
| ~a         | *psv.*     | deflected                                                           |
| ~an        | *adj.*     | bouncy                                                              |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
simple pictogram, an arrow signifying movement of an object onto and off a surface.
#### Meaning
ambiguity between whether the object was airbound or not before the jump; so you can have both e.g. a rabbit leaping and a deflection of a particle off a surface
#### Sound
- Japanese onomatopoeia "pyonpyon" (associated with bunny hopping)
- *a priori:* p=sudden movement, y=energy, on=rounded movement
